Name: Rock NPC - Rainbow Obsidian
Author: Ginger256
Description:
Howdy! Very simple "mod" here: a portrait and sprite replacer for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41279]NPC Rock[/url] that gives them a rainbow obsidian inspired look. It also retextures the rock item used to make them your roommate; easily removable if you don't want that part.

Installation is super easy, barely an inconvenience; just unzip, drag into your mod folder, and allow it to overwrite.

All credit and thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/boxosoup]boxosoup[/url] for making Rock and for letting us recolor them!

Downloads.Description: Unzip, drag and drop, overwrite all
